sepia.name: Sepia
sepia.note: The old paperback. Warmer, a little less glare.

contrast.name: High contrast
contrast.note: Everything as strong as it goes. For bright sun, or eyes that need it.

dim.name: Dim
dim.note: Quiet grey, dark print. For eyes that find a white page too bright but read a dark screen worse.

night.name: Night
night.note: Soft dark. Easier than pure black on most screens.

black.name: Black
black.note: True black. Saves power on an OLED screen.
